description: This file defines the CheckProvider class in Drupal, responsible for loading and managing access checkers from the container, applying checks to routes, and handling access check services.

classes.name: CheckProvider
classes.description: A class that loads and manages access checkers, applies them to routes, and interacts with the container to retrieve services.

methods.name: addCheckService
methods.description: Registers a new access check service with its method and applicable checks.

methods.name: getChecksNeedRequest
methods.description: Returns the list of checks that need an incoming request.

methods.name: setChecks
methods.description: Applies access checks to routes by setting options.

methods.name: loadCheck
methods.description: Loads a specific check service, ensuring it implements AccessInterface and the method is callable.
